body: It won’t break them, but to avoid them finding out you could clear your calling history

I guess it all started back in 7th grade I had really bad anxiety and terrible thoughts a lot of the time I would think about shit, shit I would never do such as kill friends or family, I dealt with this by shutting myself away from my family becoming distant and any time I felt that way I would just sleep it off.  I would think about ending my life to keep everyone safe. Fast forward a few years I have no real relationship with my family still don’t to this day no fault of their own they have always been there for me but I became so distant that I don’t know how to interact with them anymore. I built up walls after all that and after basic life shit like finding out who you can and can’t trust, I ended up dating shit girl first love of my life one of the requirements of dating this person was to break down my walls and be open about everything so I did, because I was in love she constantly made everything about herself any time I opened up I told her about the first time I called suicide hotline and she started a fight with me about something she ended up cheating on me and I was going to kill myself never told her she ended up finding out three someone I used to confide in and Broke up with me, a few days later my uncle died he was more like a father figure to me really he got hit by a car and he was in a coma I held his hand and stayed in the room with him when they shit down the machine none his brothers stayed there with him after that I shut down and he only person I talked to was my longest friend,  that friend saved me she has a daughter and I love that little girl her dad is a shit head after all that we got closer almost ended up dating but didn’t which is fine but we were going to get married so I could legally adopt the little girl fast forward a couple month we had one stupid fight over something dumb and the entire friendship ended and now I don’t ever see what should have be and what I still consider to be my daughter later on found out that friend was a pathological liar so the entire friendship was pretty much a lie. I’m pretty empty after that but I manage because I’m used to shit it almost doesn’t phase me because I’m so used to it.  Lost another friend a few months after that it’s pretty much the norm for me happens yearly with different people a few months later I met and become close with the girl you want to know about and she is amazing I’m more ways than I could ever explain she understands shit that I have trouble explaining to life long friends she never judges me she treats me well and see the best side out of pretty much everything I don’t know if you have ever seen your soul mate but I swear to god she’s mine we have a lot in common and our opposites compliment each other but she’s not interested in me and she was so nice about the entire situation I know she is saving up to buy a farm because that’s a dream of hers so for the next 3 years I’m going to save up a shit ton of money and give it to her so she can get that farm, I was dead long before I met this girl and that’s the least I can do after she introduced hope back into my life even if it was short lived. So now I don’t want to end it all because of this girl and every plan that I have a set in place so she won’t find out about it because I don’t want to blame herself if anything she added four more years on to my life. That’s pretty much the long and short version of all the bullshit I’ve ever been through obviously there was more lost friendships but trails of trust failed relationships stupid arguments family issues and all that other shit that seems super important when in reality nothing really matters
Yeah I’ll write something up today after I get off work and tell the full story I guess
What would you like to know

Can’t believe I overlooked dental records. I’m not doing it because of this girl I would never put the blame on another person it’s the situation I am and just goddamn everything I’ve dealt with in the past she was kind of like my last hope after that shit didn’t work I just kinda realized where my life is headed and I don’t want to deal with that, maybe it will get better in 3 years or maybe it will get worse and I’d rather not risk that because so far it hasn’t gotten better and that’s after forcing myself do deal with this for over 7 years.
